newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Oct farm production prices down 2.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: French Oct farm production prices down 2.2 pct.

text.p: French farm production prices fell 2.2 percent in October from September in seasonally adjusted terms, the national statistics institute INSEE said on Wednesday.
Excluding fruits and vegetables, prices fell 1.7 percent in the month, INSEE statistics showed.

Grain prices fell 5.9 percent in October under pressure from a bumper harvest. Maize prices slumped 21 percent while soft wheat prices dropped 1.8 percent and barley prices eased 0.7 percent in the month.
Oilseeds and protein seeds prices were down 6.4 percent and 5.7 percent respectively.
Vegetable prices fell 12.4 percent but fruit prices declined by only 1.3 percent.

Wholesale prices on Parisian public markets were down 3.3 percent in seasonally adjusted terms. Market prices were down 7.7 percent for beef, 7.5 percent for veal and 8.5 percent for pork, but rose 4.3 percent for sheepmeat.
Prices of industrial products necessary to farming rose by 0.5 percent in September on a unadjusted basis, INSEE said.
Energy prices increased by 6.8 percent while fertiliser prices eased 0.4 percent in September, it said.
